_comment_schemaVersion: Layout version of this file. Written by the mod - do not raise it by hand. An older file is migrated automatically on load; a file from a NEWER mod version is refused (the server logs a warning and runs on built-in defaults instead of guessing).
_comment_global: Server-wide multipliers applied on top of everything else.

global._comment_globalEuRateMultiplier: Multiplier on EVERY generator's EU/t output. 1.0 = unchanged; 2.0 = twice the generation server-wide.
global._comment_globalMachineSpeedMultiplier: Machine speed multiplier (energy-neutral): higher = machines draw more EU/t but finish proportionally faster. 1.0 = unchanged.

_comment_generators: Generator output and the environment that scales it (sky, height, weather), plus rotor/wheel consumables and generator EU buffers.

generators._comment_daylightEuPerTick: Evolved daylight-panel output in EU/t during the day.
generators._comment_fuelEuPerTick: Fuel (solid-burnable) generator output in EU/t while burning.
generators._comment_generatorBuffer: Fuel generator EU buffer. Applies to newly placed blocks.
generators._comment_geothermalBuffer: Geothermal generator EU buffer. Applies to newly placed blocks.
generators._comment_geothermalBurnTicks: Ticks of burn a geothermal generator gets per bucket of lava (20 ticks = 1 second).
generators._comment_geothermalEuPerTick: Geothermal (lava) generator output in EU/t while burning lava.
generators._comment_highAltWindMillBlocksPerBase: Blocks of height above sea level per +1 EU/t of base on the high-altitude T2 variant.
generators._comment_highAltWindMillMaxBaseEuPerTick: High-altitude wind mill (T2) clear-sky height cap in EU/t.
generators._comment_highAltWindMillMaxEuPerTick: Hard cap on high-altitude T2 wind mill EU/t after the weather multiplier.
generators._comment_highAltWindMillRainFactor: High-altitude T2 wind mill output multiplier while it is raining.
generators._comment_highAltWindMillThunderFactor: High-altitude T2 wind mill output multiplier while it is thundering.
generators._comment_lightningRodBaseBleedEuPerTick: MOD-386: EU/t the T1 tip bleeds from its capacitor into the buffer, before its grade multiplier.
generators._comment_lightningRodBaseCapacitorEu: MOD-386: capacitor size of the T1 conductor tip before its grade multiplier. Keep in step with lightningRodStrikeEu — one strike is meant to fit an empty T1 tip exactly.
generators._comment_lightningRodBuffer: MOD-386: internal EU buffer of the lightning rod generator block.
generators._comment_lightningRodMaxBleedEuPerTick: MOD-386: ceiling on the bleed rate after the grade multiplier (LV tier voltage). No multiplier can lift it.
generators._comment_lightningRodMaxCapacitorEu: MOD-386: ceiling on a conductor tip's capacitor after its grade multiplier. No multiplier can lift it.
generators._comment_lightningRodOverloadWearFactor: MOD-386: extra tip wear charged when a strike is wasted on a full capacitor (1.0 = no extra penalty).
generators._comment_lightningRodRainStrikeChanceDiv: MOD-386: one-in-N chance per tick of a strike in plain rain without thunder (vanilla never does this; the rod does). Higher = rarer.
generators._comment_lightningRodSampleTicks: MOD-386: how often the rod re-reads storm/open-sky conditions, in ticks. Cached in between, like the wind mill's height/sky sample.
generators._comment_lightningRodStrikeEu: MOD-386: EU one lightning strike delivers into the conductor tip's capacitor. Surplus over the tip's free room is lost, never banked.
generators._comment_lightningRodThunderStrikeChance: MOD-386: one-in-N chance per tick of a strike while thundering over the rod (900 ~ one strike every 45 s of storm). Higher = rarer.
generators._comment_lightningRodTipAdvancedEuPerDam: MOD-386: EU per 1 durability point of the advanced tip, scaled by its ×1.5 output.
generators._comment_lightningRodTipAdvancedMaxDamag: MOD-386: advanced conductor tip max durability (×6 the copper one). Applies at registration (restart).
generators._comment_lightningRodTipAdvancedOutputMu: MOD-386: advanced tip capacity/bleed scale — reaches both ceilings, which is the top grade's point.
generators._comment_lightningRodTipEuPerDamage: MOD-386: EU banked per 1 durability point of the T1 conductor tip (life = maxDamage × this).
generators._comment_lightningRodTipMaxDamage: MOD-386: T1 conductor tip max durability (bar). Applies at registration (restart); tune life via the EU-per-damage rate.
generators._comment_lightningRodTipOutputMultiplier: MOD-386: capacity/bleed scale of the T1 conductor tip — the ladder's 1.0 baseline.
generators._comment_lightningRodTipReinforcedEuPerD: MOD-386: EU per 1 durability point of the reinforced tip, scaled by its ×1.25 output so the life gain is purely the durability gain.
generators._comment_lightningRodTipReinforcedMaxDam: MOD-386: reinforced conductor tip max durability (×3 the copper one). Applies at registration (restart).
generators._comment_lightningRodTipReinforcedOutput: MOD-386: reinforced tip capacity/bleed scale. Applied before the caps, so it cannot raise them.
generators._comment_mobWheelBonusPercent: Extra percent of power a mob wheel runner gets while the condition its kind favours holds.
generators._comment_mobWheelEuMultiplierPercent: Mob wheel output of every species, in percent of its table power (100 = as designed).
generators._comment_mobWheelHayRestMultiplier: How many times faster an exhausted mob rests with a hay bale within 2 blocks of the wheel.
generators._comment_mobWheelRestTicks: Ticks an exhausted mob needs to rest back to full on its own, before its kind's own rest multiplier and hay.
generators._comment_mobWheelStaminaMultiplierPercen: Mob wheel stamina of every species, in percent of its table stamina (100 = as designed).
generators._comment_moonlitEuPerTick: Evolved moonlit-panel output in EU/t at night under clear sky.
generators._comment_moonlitWeatherEuPerTick: Moonlit-panel EU/t at night during rain/thunder (a weather trickle).
generators._comment_piezoGroupMaxPlates: Most piezo plates one group can join; a larger path splits into several groups.
generators._comment_piezoGroupOutputPerTick: EU/t a whole group of connected piezo plates can hand to its outlets, all outlets together.
generators._comment_piezoPlateBuffer: EU each piezo plate stores; a group of plates holds the sum. Applies to newly placed plates.
generators._comment_piezoPlateLivingPressEu: EU a piezo plate makes when a living entity presses it anew (after it was fully released).
generators._comment_piezoPlateObjectPressEu: EU a piezo plate makes when only non-living entities (items, arrows, minecarts) press it anew.
generators._comment_radiantAssembledEuPerTick: Assembled Mirror Concentrator output in EU/t during the day, before the noon peak.
generators._comment_radiantBuffer: Mirror Concentrator EU buffer. Applies to newly placed blocks.
generators._comment_radiantEuPerTick: Mirror Concentrator output in EU/t during the day, before the noon peak.
generators._comment_solarBuffer: Solar panel EU buffer. Applies to newly placed blocks.
generators._comment_solarEuPerTick: Solar panel output in EU/t under clear daytime sky. The energy system's baseline (1).
generators._comment_solarEvolveTicks: Active sky-time ticks needed to evolve a base solar panel into its T2 branch.
generators._comment_solarSkySampleTicks: How often (ticks) a solar panel re-samples sky access + weather; verdict is cached between samples.
generators._comment_solarSnowFactor: Output multiplier under snow (a snow layer above, or snowfall in a cold biome).
generators._comment_solarTransparentFactor: Output multiplier when a solar panel sees sky through a translucent block (leaves, cobweb).
generators._comment_stormWindMillMaxBaseEuPerTick: Storm wind mill (T2) clear-sky height cap in EU/t before the weather multiplier.
generators._comment_stormWindMillMaxEuPerTick: Hard cap on storm T2 wind mill EU/t after the weather multiplier.
generators._comment_stormWindMillRainFactor: Storm T2 wind mill output multiplier while it is raining.
generators._comment_stormWindMillThunderFactor: Storm T2 wind mill output multiplier while it is thundering.
generators._comment_t2WindMillBuffer: Shared EU buffer for both T2 wind mills (high-altitude + storm). Applies to newly placed blocks.
generators._comment_waterMillBuffer: Water mill EU buffer. Applies to newly placed blocks.
generators._comment_waterMillEuPerTick: Water mill EU/t per adjacent water block on its four sides (0..4 EU/t total).
generators._comment_waterMillWheelAdvancedEuPerDama: MOD-385: EU per 1 durability point of the advanced wheel, scaled by its ×1.5 output.
generators._comment_waterMillWheelAdvancedMaxDamage: MOD-385: advanced wheel max durability (×6 the wooden one). Applies at registration (restart).
generators._comment_waterMillWheelEuPerDamage: EU of production per 1 durability point of the water mill wheel (life = maxDamage × this). Read live every tick.
generators._comment_waterMillWheelMaxDamage: Water mill wheel max durability (bar). Applies at registration (restart); tune life via the EU-per-damage rate.
generators._comment_waterMillWheelOutputMultiplier: MOD-385: output scale of the plain wooden wheel — the ladder's 1.0 baseline.
generators._comment_waterMillWheelReinforcedEuPerDa: MOD-385: EU per 1 durability point of the reinforced wheel, scaled by its ×1.25 output.
generators._comment_waterMillWheelReinforcedMaxDama: MOD-385: reinforced wheel max durability (×3 the wooden one). Applies at registration (restart).
generators._comment_waterMillWheelReinforcedOutputM: MOD-385: reinforced wheel output scale. The water mill has no EU/t cap of its own — its ceiling is 4 wheel cells × waterMillEuPerTick.
generators._comment_windCloudY: Cloud deck Y: the windiest height. Wind climbs to here and collapses above it (shared by all wind mills and the Wind Gauge).
generators._comment_windDeadY: Y above which only a trace of wind remains — too little to turn any rotor.
generators._comment_windGaugePeakKmh: Clear-weather wind speed in km/h at the cloud deck — the Wind Gauge's full-scale reading.
generators._comment_windMillBuffer: Wind mill (T1) EU buffer. Applies to newly placed blocks.
generators._comment_windMillEvolveTicks: Active open-sky ticks (with rotor + evolution chip) to evolve a base wind mill into its T2 branch.
generators._comment_windMillMaxBaseEuPerTick: Wind mill base EU/t at the cloud deck; the altitude profile scales it (MOD-347).
generators._comment_windMillMaxEuPerTick: Hard cap on wind mill EU/t after the weather multiplier.
generators._comment_windMillRainFactor: Wind mill output multiplier while it is raining (not thundering).
generators._comment_windMillRotorAdvancedEuPerDamag: MOD-385: EU per 1 durability point of the advanced rotor, scaled by its ×1.5 output.
generators._comment_windMillRotorAdvancedMaxDamage: MOD-385: advanced rotor max durability (×6 the wooden one). Applies at registration (restart).
generators._comment_windMillRotorAdvancedOutputMult: MOD-385: advanced rotor output scale. Applied before the mill's cap.
generators._comment_windMillRotorEuPerDamage: EU of production per 1 durability point of the wind mill rotor (life = maxDamage × this). Read live every tick.
generators._comment_windMillRotorMaxDamage: Wind mill rotor max durability (bar). Applies at registration (restart); tune life via the EU-per-damage rate. Shared by all three wind mills.
generators._comment_windMillRotorOutputMultiplier: MOD-385: output scale of the plain wooden rotor — the ladder's 1.0 baseline. Raising it buffs every wind mill, not just upgraded ones.
generators._comment_windMillRotorReinforcedEuPerDam: MOD-385: EU per 1 durability point of the reinforced rotor. Scaled by its ×1.25 output so the life gain is purely the durability gain.
generators._comment_windMillRotorReinforcedMaxDamag: MOD-385: reinforced rotor max durability (×3 the wooden one). Applies at registration (restart).
generators._comment_windMillRotorReinforcedOutputMu: MOD-385: reinforced rotor output scale. Applied before the mill's cap, so it cannot raise windMillMaxEuPerTick.
generators._comment_windMillSampleTicks: How often (ticks) a wind mill re-samples height/sky/weather; rate is cached in between.
generators._comment_windMillStormWearFactor: Extra rotor wear multiplier while running in rain/thunder (1.0 = off). Applies to all three wind mills.
generators._comment_windMillThunderFactor: Wind mill output multiplier while it is thundering.
generators._comment_windRidgeFactor: Fraction of full wind strength reached at a mill branch's ridge; the rest is gained over the shoulder up to windCloudY.
generators._comment_windTraceFactor: Fraction of full wind strength left above windDeadY (readable on the gauge, 0 EU/t for mills).

_comment_machines: Processing machines: EU/t, operation durations, internal buffers, overclocker chips, the incubator mutation table, the condenser and the drone station.

machines._comment_alloySmelterDuration: Fallback ticks one alloying operation takes at 1.0 speed (MOD-064); shipped recipe energy 1200 / alloySmelterEuPerTick 8 = 150.
machines._comment_alloySmelterEuPerTick: EU/t the alloy smelter draws while running (MOD-064). Four times the machine standard, like the incubator.
machines._comment_assemblerBuffer: EU buffer of the assembler (MOD-275) — 25 operations at 480 EU each.
machines._comment_assemblerDuration: Ticks one assembler craft takes at 1.0 speed (MOD-275). 40 = 2 seconds, the pace of the genre.
machines._comment_assemblerEuPerTick: EU/tick the assembler draws while crafting (MOD-275). MV rate: six times an LV machine.
machines._comment_canningFoodValuePerCan: Food value in tenths (nutrition + saturation) the canning machine consumes per ration. Must exceed the ration's own 96, or canning becomes a food duplicator.
machines._comment_canningMachineDuration: Ticks the canning machine takes per ration at 1.0 speed; x machineEuPerTick 2 = 200 EU per ration.
machines._comment_ceramicPlatesFromPress: Plates one carbon briquette yields when a piston fires into the water it floats in.
machines._comment_ceramicPressRedstoneCost: Redstone dust the press consumes per briquette, alongside the briquette itself.
machines._comment_clotThresholdI: MOD-393: banked EU needed before the condenser can yield a tier-I energy clot.
machines._comment_clotThresholdII: MOD-393: banked EU for a tier-II clot (four times tier I).
machines._comment_clotThresholdIII: MOD-393: banked EU for a tier-III clot (four times tier II).
machines._comment_compressorDuration: Ticks a compressor takes per operation at 1.0 speed.
machines._comment_condenserCapacity: MOD-393: ceiling of the energy condenser's bank; equals the tier-III clot threshold, so it stops drawing once nothing higher is reachable.
machines._comment_condenserInputRate: MOD-393: EU/t the energy condenser accepts — one MV packet, about 32 basic solar panels. Machines are protected by the network's serve order, not by this number; absorbing a bigger surplus means placing more condensers.
machines._comment_crystalFarmBuffer: Energy buffer of a crystal farm controller, in EU.
machines._comment_crystalFarmDoorAutoCloseTicks: Ticks a hand-opened greenhouse door stays open before sealing itself; a door held open by redstone ignores this.
machines._comment_crystalFarmDoorOccupiedRecheckT: Ticks the greenhouse door waits before re-testing a doorway that still has someone standing in it.
machines._comment_crystalFarmEuPerGrowth: EU one boosted growth event costs; charged only when the event actually happens.
machines._comment_crystalFarmGrowthChanceDivisor: 1-in-this chance a seedbed advances on one attempt with no water and no power; lower it to single digits to watch a farm work during a test.
machines._comment_crystalFarmGrowthIntervalTicks: Ticks between growth attempts on every seedbed in a greenhouse.
machines._comment_crystalFarmPowerSpeedup: Factor a powered attempt cuts the crystal growth divisor by, on top of water.
machines._comment_crystalFarmRoomMaxCells: Largest interior volume of a crystal greenhouse, in blocks; past it the room reads as unsealed.
machines._comment_crystalFarmRoomMaxSpan: How far from its controller a greenhouse fill may reach, in blocks; keeps a leaking room from scanning into unloaded terrain.
machines._comment_crystalFarmRoomMinCells: Smallest interior volume of a crystal greenhouse, in blocks; the room may be any shape, so this is a volume rather than an edge length.
machines._comment_crystalFarmScanIntervalTicks: Ticks between full re-scans of a crystal greenhouse by its controller; also refreshes its seedbed list and water check.
machines._comment_crystalFarmSolutionPerGrowthMb: mB of nutrient solution one sprinkler-boosted growth event costs; charged only when the event happens.
machines._comment_crystalFarmSprinklerSpeedup: Factor a sprinkler in the room cuts the crystal growth divisor by, on top of water and power.
machines._comment_crystalFarmWaterSpeedup: Factor water in the room cuts the crystal growth divisor by.
machines._comment_crystalSeedbedChargesPerShard: Buds one amethyst shard buys when fed to a seedbed; shards go in one per click, so this is the exchange rate of the whole farm.
machines._comment_distillationColumnDuration: Fallback ticks one distillation takes at 1.0 speed; shipped recipe energy 400 / machineEuPerTick 2 = 200.
machines._comment_distillationColumnWarmupTicks: Ticks a cold distillation column heats (at machineEuPerTick) before it can distil; cooling is twice as slow.
machines._comment_electricFurnaceDuration: Ticks an electric furnace takes per smelt at 1.0 speed.
machines._comment_electricHeaterBuffer: Electric Heater EU buffer. Applies to newly placed blocks.
machines._comment_electricHeaterEuPerTick: EU/t an Electric Heater spends while the Vulcanizer directly above it advances; idle heater draws nothing.
machines._comment_electricHeaterWarmupTicks: MOD-418: paid heat ticks a cold Electric Heater needs before it supplies tier-3 heat (x3 output); until then it supplies tier 2 (x2). Cooling is twice as slow.
machines._comment_extractorDuration: Ticks an extractor takes per operation at 1.0 speed.
machines._comment_fermenterBiofuelCommon: mB of biofuel a batch of ordinary harvest brews (wheat, carrots, melon slices, raw meat).
machines._comment_fermenterBiofuelPoor: mB of biofuel a batch of the cheapest organic tier brews (seeds, grass, leaves, rot).
machines._comment_fermenterBiofuelRich: mB of biofuel a batch of processed or dense feedstock brews (golden carrots, cooked food, hay blocks).
machines._comment_fermenterDuration: Fallback ticks one fermenter batch takes at 1.0 speed; shipped recipe energy 600 / machineEuPerTick 2 = 300.
machines._comment_fermenterWaterPerOp: mB of water a fermenter batch consumes (not part of the recipe JSON).
machines._comment_galvanicBathDuration: Fallback ticks a galvanic bath operation takes at 1.0 speed; shipped recipe energy 1000 / machineEuPerTick 2 = 500.
machines._comment_galvanicBathWaterPerOp: mB of water a galvanic bath consumes per completed operation (not part of the recipe JSON).
machines._comment_gardenDroneBuffer: Garden Drone station internal EU buffer.
machines._comment_gardenDroneEuPerAction: EU per completed Garden Drone action (till/plant/fertilize/harvest/weed); idle costs nothing.
machines._comment_gardenDroneFlightTicksPerBlock: Ticks the Garden Drone flies per block of distance before its action lands.
machines._comment_gardenDroneRange: Garden Drone zone-scan radius in blocks around the station.
machines._comment_gardenDroneScanIntervalTicks: Ticks between Garden Drone zone rebuilds after cache invalidation.
machines._comment_incubatorEuPerTick: EU/t the incubator draws while running (4x the machine standard).
machines._comment_incubatorWaterPerOp: mB of water an incubator attempt drinks (not part of the recipe JSON).
machines._comment_incubatorWaterSpeedBonus: Per cent faster an incubator runs while its nutrient bath has water (0 disables).
machines._comment_ironFurnaceCookTime: Ticks the (fuel-based) iron furnace takes to smelt one item. Vanilla furnace = 200.
machines._comment_maceratorBuffer: Macerator EU buffer. Applies to newly placed blocks.
machines._comment_maceratorDuration: Ticks a macerator takes per operation at 1.0 speed.
machines._comment_machineBuffer: Shared EU buffer for ordinary LV processing machines: electric furnace, compressor, extractor, sawmill, polymerizer and vulcanizer. Applies to newly placed blocks.
machines._comment_machineEuPerTick: Base EU/t a processing machine draws while running (energy per operation = this x its duration).
machines._comment_mobRepellerBuffer: Mob Repeller LV internal EU buffer.
machines._comment_mobRepellerBufferHv: Mob Repeller HV internal EU buffer.
machines._comment_mobRepellerBufferMv: Mob Repeller MV internal EU buffer.
machines._comment_mobRepellerEuPerTick: Mob Repeller LV field upkeep in EU per tick while enabled (constant drain, not per expulsion).
machines._comment_mobRepellerEuPerTickHv: Mob Repeller HV field upkeep in EU per tick.
machines._comment_mobRepellerEuPerTickMv: Mob Repeller MV field upkeep in EU per tick.
machines._comment_mobRepellerEvolveKillsHv: Personal hostile kills to evolve the MV repeller into HV; also the vessel hard cap.
machines._comment_mobRepellerEvolveKillsMv: Personal hostile kills a Soul Vessel needs to evolve the LV repeller into MV.
machines._comment_mobRepellerRange: Mob Repeller LV zone radius in blocks (a cube around the block).
machines._comment_mobRepellerRangeHv: Mob Repeller HV zone radius in blocks.
machines._comment_mobRepellerRangeMv: Mob Repeller MV zone radius in blocks.
machines._comment_mobRepellerScanIntervalTicks: Ticks between Mob Repeller zone sweeps (the upkeep drain still applies every tick).
machines._comment_mutationAttemptsPerIngot: Mutation attempts one uranium ingot powers before it burns to ash.
machines._comment_mutationChanceCap: Ceiling on the total mutation success chance (base + gene bonus).
machines._comment_mutationChanceCreate: Base success chance of a create mutation (0..1).
machines._comment_mutationChanceDuplicate: Base success chance of a duplicate mutation (0..1).
machines._comment_mutationChanceTransform: Base success chance of a transform mutation (0..1).
machines._comment_mutationDurationCreate: Ticks an incubator create attempt takes at 1.0 speed.
machines._comment_mutationDurationDuplicate: Ticks an incubator duplicate attempt takes at 1.0 speed.
machines._comment_mutationDurationTransform: Ticks an incubator transform attempt takes at 1.0 speed.
machines._comment_mutationGradeEpic: Share of successful mutations rolling the epic grade.
machines._comment_mutationGradeLegendary: Share of successful mutations rolling the legendary grade.
machines._comment_mutationGradeRare: Share of successful mutations rolling the rare grade.
machines._comment_mutationSlagChance: Share of attempts yielding irradiated slag instead of an empty miss.
machines._comment_overclockerEuFactor: MOD-392: EU/t multiplier per overclocker chip (2.0 = each chip doubles the draw). With 0.8 speed this makes every chip cost 60% more energy per operation.
machines._comment_overclockerMaxPerMachine: MOD-392: absolute ceiling on overclocker chips in one machine; the tier cap (base EU/t x factor^n <= tier voltage) usually bites first.
machines._comment_overclockerSpeedFactor: MOD-392: duration multiplier per overclocker chip (0.8 = each chip cuts one operation to 80% of its length).
machines._comment_polymerizerDuration: Ticks a polymerizer takes to turn one bucket of oil into raw rubber at 1.0 speed.
machines._comment_reactorBareInstabilityCapacity: Top of the bare reactor's instability scale.
machines._comment_reactorBareInstabilityPerRod: Instability a bare reactor gains per rod per tick; against the settle rate this sets how many racks a lava farm may carry.
machines._comment_reactorBareMeltIntervalTicks: Ticks between melts under a bare reactor carrying one rod; divided by the rod count.
machines._comment_reactorBareMeltMinIntervalTicks: Shortest gap between two melts under a bare reactor however large the cluster grows.
machines._comment_reactorBareMeltRadius: Blocks around a working bare reactor within which the scenery melts.
machines._comment_reactorBarePowerCap: Hard ceiling on a bare reactor's output in EU/t, however many rods are piled into it.
machines._comment_reactorBarePowerPercent: Share of the sealed-room output a bare reactor keeps, in percent.
machines._comment_reactorBareSearchRadius: Blocks a controller with no sealed room reaches when looking for fuel racks; wider than the melt radius.
machines._comment_reactorBareSettlePermille: Share of current instability a bare reactor sheds per tick, per mille.
machines._comment_reactorBlastBasePower: Explosion power of a reactor carrying no rods; below what it takes to break a reactor wall.
machines._comment_reactorBlastCountdownMaxTicks: Longest countdown between a pinned gauge and the explosion, in ticks.
machines._comment_reactorBlastCountdownMinTicks: Shortest countdown between a pinned gauge and the explosion, in ticks; rolled fresh per accident.
machines._comment_reactorBlastEnabled: When true, a core pinned at the top of its scale counts down and explodes. false keeps the countdown, the siren and the panel and changes no block.
machines._comment_reactorBlastFire: Whether the blast sets fire to what it touches.
machines._comment_reactorBlastLavaCells: Lava sources poured into the crater, only into cells the explosion itself destroyed.
machines._comment_reactorBlastMaxPower: Hard ceiling on explosion power; a sealed room contains everything up to about 24.
machines._comment_reactorBlastPowerPerTenRods: Explosion power added per ten rods burning when the countdown ran out.
machines._comment_reactorBlastReleaseTicks: How long the core must stay under a hundred percent before an armed countdown is called off; stops a redstone clock resetting it.
machines._comment_reactorBuffer: EU buffer of the reactor controller.
machines._comment_reactorButtonPressTicks: Ticks the reactor button stays pressed before releasing itself.
machines._comment_reactorColumnSteamCapacity: Steam a single reactor column holds before cooling stalls, in mB.
machines._comment_reactorColumnWaterCapacity: Water a single reactor column holds, in mB.
machines._comment_reactorCoolantTargetPercent: Percentage of the heat scale the reactor must fall below before the warning siren can sound again; below the warning threshold on purpose.
machines._comment_reactorDoorOccupiedRecheckTicks: Ticks the airlock waits before re-testing a doorway that still has someone standing in it.
machines._comment_reactorDoorOpenTicks: Ticks the reactor airlock stays open after a redstone pulse before closing itself; holding the signal does not extend it.
machines._comment_reactorDoorSlideTicks: Ticks the airlock panel takes to slide its full two blocks; cosmetic only, the open state still flips in one tick.
machines._comment_reactorEuPerRod: EU/t one fully lowered uranium rod contributes, before neighbour bonuses.
machines._comment_reactorFalloutDecayChancePercen: Percent chance per random tick that a fallout block fades one step; water on top doubles it.
machines._comment_reactorFalloutDosePerBlock: Dose one fallout block delivers per radiation sweep; must exceed radiationTickInterval or its own decay cancels it.
machines._comment_reactorFalloutEnabled: Whether an explosion leaves irradiated ground behind.
machines._comment_reactorFalloutMaxBlocksCounted: How many fallout blocks one player ever counts, however large the scar.
machines._comment_reactorFalloutRadius: Blocks around the epicentre within which fallout may settle, on top of what the blast destroyed.
machines._comment_reactorHeatCapacity: Maximum of the reactor heat scale.
machines._comment_reactorHeatLossPermille: Extra heat a stopped reactor room sheds per tick, in thousandths of the current temperature.
machines._comment_reactorHeatNeighbourBonusPercen: Extra heat in percent per adjacent loaded reactor column; larger than the energy bonus, which is what makes a dense core hotter for the same power.
machines._comment_reactorHeatPerRod: Heat units added per active rod per tick at full depth.
machines._comment_reactorHeatPerWater: Heat units carried away by one mB of water as it boils into steam.
machines._comment_reactorHeatWarnPercent: Percentage of the heat scale above which the reactor reports running hot.
machines._comment_reactorMeltWarnTicks: Ticks between a block being marked for melting and turning to lava; the pointed warning the player can act on.
machines._comment_reactorMeltdownHeatRelief: Heat carried away by one melted block of the room's contents; what makes a meltdown self-limiting.
machines._comment_reactorMeltdownIntervalTicks: Ticks between two blocks of the room's contents melting while the core is over the meltdown line.
machines._comment_reactorMeltdownMeltsBlocks: When true, an overheating sealed room melts its own contents, a working sealed room melts the ordinary fluid and steam pipes inside it, and a working bare reactor melts the scenery around it. false keeps every cue and changes no block.
machines._comment_reactorMeltdownStartPercent: Percentage of the heat scale at which a sealed room starts melting its own contents; between the warning line and the top.
machines._comment_reactorNeighbourBonusPercent: Extra output in percent granted per adjacent loaded fuel assembly; heat scales with it too.
machines._comment_reactorNozzleBuffer: Steam a nozzle holds, in mB.
machines._comment_reactorNozzlePlumeIntervalTicks: Ticks a steam nozzle gathers its vented steam before drawing one geyser burst for it.
machines._comment_reactorNozzleVentRate: Steam a nozzle releases into the world per tick, in mB.
machines._comment_reactorOutletBuffer: EU a single reactor outlet holds before a cable drains it.
machines._comment_reactorPassiveCooling: Heat units a stopped reactor room bleeds away on its own each tick regardless of temperature; a running one sheds nothing but what its water carries.
machines._comment_reactorPipeMeltIntervalTicks: Ticks between two ordinary fluid or steam pipes melting inside a working sealed reactor room; the reinforced pipes are immune.
machines._comment_reactorPortThroughput: Fluid a single reactor inlet passes per tick, in mB.
machines._comment_reactorRodBurnTicks: Ticks of burn in one uranium fuel rod at full control-rod depth.
machines._comment_reactorRoomMaxGlassPercent: Largest share of a reactor shell that may be glass, in percent; above it the room reports a weak structure.
machines._comment_reactorRoomMaxInner: Largest interior edge of a reactor room, in blocks; bounds both the scan cost and how much one room can hold.
machines._comment_reactorRoomMinInner: Smallest interior edge of a reactor room, in blocks.
machines._comment_reactorScanIntervalTicks: Ticks between full re-scans of a reactor room by its controller; catches shell changes out of neighbour range.
machines._comment_reactorSteamPlumeIntervalTicks: Ticks between the steam puffs over a sealed reactor room's boiling column stacks.
machines._comment_reactorSteamPlumeStacksPerPulse: Boiling column stacks that puff steam in one pulse; the rest take turns on later pulses.
machines._comment_recyclerBatchMass: Slag mass a recycler batch must reach before it casts a briquette.
machines._comment_recyclerBladesDiamondMaxDamage: Items a diamond recycler blade set grinds before it wears out.
machines._comment_recyclerBladesIronMaxDamage: Items an iron recycler blade set grinds before it wears out.
machines._comment_recyclerBladesTemperedMaxDamage: Items a tempered-iron recycler blade set grinds before it wears out.
machines._comment_recyclerDuration: Ticks a recycler takes to grind one item at 1.0 speed, before the blade grade.
machines._comment_recyclerEuPerTick: EU per tick a recycler draws while grinding.
machines._comment_repairBenchEuPerTick: EU/t the component repair bench draws while repairing (MOD-384). Four times the machine standard, like the alloy smelter.
machines._comment_repairBenchMaxDamageDecayPercen: MOD-384: percent of the ORIGINAL durability ceiling one repair burns, linear (1000 -> 800 -> 600 -> 400). Also sets how many repairs a part gets (four at 20%). 0 disables the decay and the limit with it.
machines._comment_repairBenchTier1EuCost: MOD-384: EU one repair of a T1 rotor/wheel costs (material: 1 iron plate). 9600 EU / 8 EU-t = 1200 ticks (60 s).
machines._comment_repairBenchTier2EuCost: MOD-384: EU one repair of a reinforced rotor/wheel costs (material: 1 tempered iron plate). 19200 EU / 8 EU-t = 2400 ticks (120 s).
machines._comment_repairBenchTier3EuCost: MOD-384: EU one repair of an advanced rotor/wheel costs (material: 1 electronic circuit). 28800 EU / 8 EU-t = 3600 ticks (180 s).
machines._comment_sawmillDuration: Ticks a sawmill takes per cut at 1.0 speed (all four modes).
machines._comment_sprinklerRange: Sprinkler spray radius in blocks around the block.
machines._comment_sprinklerSolutionPerActionMb: mB of nutrient solution one successful spray on a vanilla crop costs.
machines._comment_sprinklerTankMb: Sprinkler tank size in mB; also caps how fast a pipe can fill it.
machines._comment_thermalCentrifugeDuration: Fallback ticks a thermal centrifuge operation takes at 1.0 speed; shipped recipe energy 800 / thermalCentrifugeEuPerTick 4 = 200.
machines._comment_thermalCentrifugeEuPerTick: EU/t a thermal centrifuge spends while spinning up or processing; with the heater below the pair draws 10 EU/t.
machines._comment_thermalCentrifugeIdleEuPerTick: EU/t a spun-up thermal centrifuge spends holding revolutions with nothing to process.
machines._comment_thermalCentrifugeSpinupTicks: Ticks a stopped centrifuge rotor needs to reach working speed after the redstone signal arrives; it sheds speed at half this rate.
machines._comment_upgradeTableDuration: Ticks the Upgrade Table takes to fit one module.
machines._comment_upgradeTableEuPerTick: EU/t the Upgrade Table draws while fitting a module.
machines._comment_vulcanizerDuration: Fallback ticks a vulcanizer operation takes at 1.0 speed; shipped recipe energy 400 / machineEuPerTick 2 = 200.
machines._comment_workstationEuPerTick: MOD-483: EU/t the assembled Workstation draws while powered. Charged per elapsed tick, at most a second per debit.
machines._comment_workstationSkillPurchaseEu: MOD-483: EU the Workstation spends per skill learned. Flat - the Ala-Fragment cost already scales with depth.

_comment_storage: EU stores: battery box, reinforced storage, charging station, and the channel that feeds a non-cascade sink from a store.

storage._comment_batteryBoxBuffer: Battery Box EU buffer. Applies to newly placed blocks (already-placed keep their capacity until the chunk reloads).
storage._comment_cesuBuffer: Reinforced Energy Storage (MV) EU buffer. Applies to newly placed blocks (already-placed keep their capacity until the chunk reloads).
storage._comment_chargePadBuffer: Charging Station EU buffer. Sized to a visit, not an operation: the station banks power while idle so it can charge a player's gear in one burst. Applies to newly placed blocks.
storage._comment_chargePadInputRate: Max EU/t the Charging Station accepts from the grid. A ceiling, not a promise - a copper cable delivers 12, a gold one 48, an adjacent Battery Box 32.
storage._comment_chargePadOutputRate: Max EU/t the Charging Station hands to the player standing on it, shared across every powered item they carry (each item still capped by its own input rate).
storage._comment_storageFeedRate: EU/tick a storage block feeds a non-cascade sink (teleporter, charging station) over cable. 0 disables the channel.
storage._comment_storageFeedReserveFraction: Share of its capacity a storage block keeps for itself when feeding a non-cascade sink over cable (0..1). Below this line the channel is shut, so a teleporter can never drain the base's bank.

_comment_cables: Cable grades: per-segment buffer (which is also the segment throughput), packet caps and per-block loss.

cables._comment_cableBuffer: Per-cable working EU buffer — the live transport-segment buffer (MOD-070). Tiny by design so a wall of cables can't be used as bulk storage. Applies to newly placed cables.
cables._comment_copperCableLossPerBlock: Fraction of throughput attenuated per copper cable block (0.02 = 2% of the remaining flow per block).
cables._comment_electrumCableBuffer: Per-segment working EU buffer of an electrum (HV) cable = its real throughput (192 EU/t, 4x gold).
cables._comment_electrumCableLossPerBlock: Fraction of throughput attenuated per electrum cable block (0.005 = 0.5% of the remaining flow per block; the lowest in the mod - electrum pays in craft cost, not in distance).
cables._comment_goldCableBuffer: Per-segment working EU buffer of a gold (MV) cable = its real throughput (48 EU/t, 4x copper).
cables._comment_goldCableLossPerBlock: Fraction of throughput attenuated per gold cable block (0.03 = 3% of the remaining flow per block; worse than copper by design - gold buys throughput, not distance).
cables._comment_insulationLossMultiplier: Multiplier applied to bare-cable attenuation for rubber-insulated tin/copper cables (0.5 = half the loss; throughput and packet cap are unchanged).
cables._comment_tinCableBuffer: Per-segment working EU buffer of a tin cable = its real throughput (8 EU/t, narrower than copper's 12).
cables._comment_tinCableLossPerBlock: Fraction of throughput attenuated per tin cable block (0.006 = 0.6% of the remaining flow per block; a 1 EU/t solar trickle floors to zero loss).
cables._comment_tinCablePacketCap: Per-tick ceiling on EU drawn from one source through a tin cable (8 EU/t, below the LV tier voltage by design).

_comment_safety: Bare-cable shock hazard and the insulating stands that soften it.

safety._comment_bareCableShockEnabled: When true, energized bare cables damage players on direct contact and emit shock feedback. false disables the entire mechanic.
safety._comment_bareCableShockHvDamage: Damage from direct contact with an energized bare HV cable, in half-hearts.
safety._comment_bareCableShockInsulationDamageP: Absorbed shock damage that costs one durability point on each worn insulating piece (higher = the set lasts longer; contact is once per second, so this is a rate).
safety._comment_bareCableShockInsulationPerPiec: Percent of a bare cable's shock cut by one worn piece of insulating armour (25 = a full four-piece set is immune; 0 disables the set's protection).
safety._comment_bareCableShockLvDamage: Damage from direct contact with an energized bare LV cable, in half-hearts.
safety._comment_bareCableShockMvDamage: Damage from direct contact with an energized bare MV cable, in half-hearts.
safety._comment_bareCableShockProximityRadius: Extra blocks the shock hazard reaches beyond a bare cable segment's own cell in every direction (0 = direct-touch only).
safety._comment_geigerBusyThreshold: Field at which the counter moves from occasional clicks to an audible rattle.
safety._comment_geigerFaintThreshold: Field at which the Geiger counter starts clicking. Below it the instrument is silent.
safety._comment_geigerLoudThreshold: Field at which the counter's rattle becomes dense.
safety._comment_geigerOffScaleThreshold: Field above which the Geiger counter stops telling levels apart and just roars.
safety._comment_geigerOreRadius: How far a Geiger counter hears uranium ore still in the rock. Ore in the wall gives no dose at all — this only moves the needle. 0 disables the ore scan.
safety._comment_geigerRadius: How far a Geiger counter hears radiation. Larger than the radius radiation actually reaches, on purpose: the counter has to warn before the dose starts.
safety._comment_geigerVolumePercent: Loudness of the Geiger counter's clicks, in percent. 0 silences it; players also have the vanilla Players volume slider.
safety._comment_radiationContainerDepth: How deep to look inside carried containers for radioactive contents; 1 = a shulker box of fuel rods irradiates its carrier.
safety._comment_radiationContainerMaxItems: How many items' worth of radiation one container in the world may leak regardless of how much it holds; 0 stops containers radiating entirely. Without a cap a chest of refined uranium killed instantly across the whole radius.
safety._comment_radiationDamageIntervalLevel2: Ticks between radiation hits at dose level II.
safety._comment_radiationDamageIntervalLevel3: Ticks between radiation hits at dose level III.
safety._comment_radiationDamageIntervalLevel4: Ticks between radiation hits at the top of the dose scale.
safety._comment_radiationDamageLethal: Damage per radiation hit at the top of the dose scale, in half-hearts.
safety._comment_radiationDamageSick: Damage per radiation hit below the lethal line, in half-hearts.
safety._comment_radiationDoseCapacity: Depth of the radiation dose scale in ticks; also the time a player at the top of the scale needs to recover once clear of every source.
safety._comment_radiationDoseHighPerItem: Dose per sweep per carried item of tag radioactive_high (refined uranium, isotopes, fuel rods). Uncapped: a loose stack kills.
safety._comment_radiationDoseLowPerItem: Dose per sweep per carried item of tag radioactive_low (ore, dust, shavings, depleted rods).
safety._comment_radiationDoseMediumPerItem: Dose per sweep per carried item of tag radioactive_medium (uranium ingots and plates).
safety._comment_radiationDosePerSuitDurability: Dose the shielding suit absorbs per point of durability spent; the suit is a consumable, not a permanent answer.
safety._comment_radiationEnabled: When true, uranium and fuelled reactor rods irradiate players. false disables the entire mechanic, including suit wear.
safety._comment_radiationGroundRadius: Blocks around the player in which dropped radioactive items are counted as a source.
safety._comment_radiationLowDoseCapPercent: Percent of the dose scale that tag radioactive_low alone can reach; inside level I on purpose, so raw ore sickens but never kills.
safety._comment_radiationMobConvertPercent: Percent of the dose scale at which an irradiated villager or cow transforms.
safety._comment_radiationMobDamageIntervalTicks: Ticks between the light hits an irradiated villager takes before it transforms.
safety._comment_radiationMobsEnabled: When true, radiation turns villagers and wandering traders into zombie villagers and cows into mooshrooms. false disables all three transformations.
safety._comment_radiationRodDosePerTick: Dose per sweep from a fuelled reactor rod in line of sight, before shielding.
safety._comment_radiationRodShieldCapPercent: Ceiling on suit protection against a rod in line of sight; below 100 on purpose, so a full suit buys working time inside a live reactor rather than immunity.
safety._comment_radiationShieldPerPiecePercent: Percent of incoming dose each worn shielding-suit piece blocks; four pieces block all ordinary exposure.
safety._comment_radiationSourceRadius: Blocks a fuelled rod irradiates through open air; a shell block in the way stops it entirely.
safety._comment_radiationSymptomIntervalTicks: Ticks between re-applying the visible radiation symptoms (nausea, weakness, hunger).
safety._comment_radiationTickInterval: Ticks between radiation exposure sweeps per player.
safety._comment_shockGuardGlassHitChance: Chance (0..1) a shock still lands through a glass insulating stand under a bare cable (1 = no protection, 0 = blocks every hit).
safety._comment_shockGuardGraceTicks: Contact ticks a player is spared after an insulating stand absorbs a shock, so the reduced chance is per contact rather than re-rolled every tick.
safety._comment_shockGuardWoodHitChance: Chance (0..1) a shock still lands through a plank insulating stand under a bare cable (1 = no protection, 0 = blocks every hit).
safety._comment_shockGuardWoolHitChance: Chance (0..1) a shock still lands through a wool insulating stand under a bare cable (1 = no protection, 0 = blocks every hit).

_comment_network: Voltage tiers, buffer capacities per tier, and per-tick network budgets.

network._comment_fluidNetworksPerTick: Fluid networks processed per server tick; the rest round-robin to later ticks.
network._comment_networkAnalyzerMaxTraversedNetw: Cap on networks the Network Analyzer's Traverse mode walks (visualization only, never affects energy).
network._comment_networksPerTick: Max awake energy networks processed per server tick; the rest are deferred round-robin.
network._comment_tierHvCapacity: Default internal buffer capacity for HV machines. EnergyTier.HV reads it live.
network._comment_tierHvVoltage: Max packet voltage for the HV tier (4x MV by convention). EnergyTier.HV reads it live.
network._comment_tierLvCapacity: Default internal buffer capacity for LV machines that do not override it. EnergyTier.LV reads it live.
network._comment_tierLvVoltage: Max packet voltage (EU) and per-tick transfer cap for the LV tier (cable, generator, machine, storage). EnergyTier.LV reads it live.
network._comment_tierMvCapacity: Default internal buffer capacity for MV machines. EnergyTier.MV reads it live.
network._comment_tierMvVoltage: Max packet voltage for the MV tier (4x LV by convention). EnergyTier.MV reads it live.

_comment_tools: Powered items the player carries or wears: buffers, charge rates and running costs.

tools._comment_batteryBuffer: Battery EU buffer, PER ITEM (a stack of 16 carries 16x this).
tools._comment_batteryInputRate: Max EU/t one battery accepts while charging in a slot.
tools._comment_batteryTransferPerUse: EU one right-click moves from the battery into the item in the other hand.
tools._comment_electricBowEuPerShot: EU the bow spends per powered shot (below this it shoots as a plain bow for free).
tools._comment_electricBowInputRate: Max EU/t the bow accepts while charging in a slot.
tools._comment_electricChainsawEuPerBlock: EU the chainsaw spends per block cut at powered speed (below this it cuts at hand speed for free).
tools._comment_electricChainsawInputRate: Max EU/t the chainsaw accepts while charging in a slot.
tools._comment_electricDrillColumnEuPerBlock: EU the drill spends per extra block of a column bore (the block above and below the one hit).
tools._comment_electricDrillEuPerBlock: EU the drill spends per block mined at powered speed (below this it mines at hand speed for free).
tools._comment_electricDrillInputRate: Max EU/t the drill accepts while charging in a slot.
tools._comment_electricDrillNetheriteTipBuffer: Netherite-Tipped Electric Drill EU buffer (the two tiers below share electricDrillBuffer).
tools._comment_electricDrillTorchEuCost: EU the drill spends to place a torch on right-click.
tools._comment_electricHoeEuPerBlock: EU the hoe spends per block broken at powered speed (below this it breaks at hand speed for free). Tilling is powered too and is billed separately by electricHoeTillEuCost.
tools._comment_electricHoeInputRate: Max EU/t the hoe accepts while charging in a slot.
tools._comment_electricHoeTillEuCost: EU the hoe spends per successful right-click conversion (tilling soil).
tools._comment_electricSaberEuPerHit: EU the saber spends per powered hit (below this it hits as a plain sword for free).
tools._comment_electricSaberInputRate: Max EU/t the saber accepts while charging in a slot.
tools._comment_electricSaberShockSeconds: Seconds of Slowness II a powered saber hit leaves on the target (0 disables).
tools._comment_electricShovelEuPerBlock: EU the shovel spends per block dug at powered speed (below this it digs at hand speed for free).
tools._comment_electricShovelInputRate: Max EU/t the shovel accepts while charging in a slot.
tools._comment_energyCrystalBuffer: EU a blank Energy Crystal must absorb to become a crystal. Priming time is this divided by the charge rate below.
tools._comment_energyCrystalInputRate: Max EU/t an Energy Crystal accepts in a charge slot. A charge slot caps at 128 regardless, so higher values do nothing until an HV item charger exists.
tools._comment_energyPackInputRate: Max EU/t the Energy Pack accepts while charging in a slot.
tools._comment_energyPackOutputRate: Max EU/t the worn Energy Pack hands out to powered items in the inventory.
tools._comment_fluxweaveBuffer: EU buffer of each Fluxweave armour piece.
tools._comment_fluxweaveChargedToughness: Extra armour toughness on a charged Fluxweave chestplate.
tools._comment_fluxweaveFallDamageReductionPer: Percent of fall damage Fluxweave boots absorb while charged (clamped to 90 in code).
tools._comment_fluxweaveInputRate: Max EU/t a Fluxweave piece accepts while charging in a slot.
tools._comment_fluxweaveKnockbackResistance: Percent of knockback resisted by a charged Fluxweave chestplate.
tools._comment_fluxweaveOxygenBonus: OXYGEN_BONUS levels granted by a charged Fluxweave helmet.
tools._comment_fluxweaveRegenEuPerHeal: EU the Fluxweave helmet spends per half-heart healed by the 4/4 set bonus.
tools._comment_fluxweaveRunSpeedPercent: Percent added to run speed by charged Fluxweave leggings.
tools._comment_fluxweaveStepHeightBonus: Extra step height (hundredths of a block) from charged Fluxweave leggings with the assist toggled on.
tools._comment_fluxweaveSwimEfficiency: Percent of water movement efficiency granted by a charged Fluxweave helmet.
tools._comment_fluxweaveUpkeepEuPerSecond: EU/second a charged, worn Fluxweave piece burns to keep its bonuses on.
tools._comment_geigerWallPermille: Promille of a shielded source the Geiger counter still hears (dose is unaffected).
tools._comment_jetpackEuPerTick: EU the jetpack burns per tick of thrust (jump held while airborne).
tools._comment_jetpackFlightLightLevel: Light level (0-15) a thrusting jetpack casts around the flyer; 0 disables the glow.
tools._comment_jetpackInputRate: Max EU/t the jetpack accepts while charging in a slot.
tools._comment_jetpackMaxY: Altitude ceiling (block Y) above which the jetpack engine refuses to thrust.
tools._comment_lapotronCrystalBuffer: EU a blank Lapotron Crystal must absorb. It fills from empty - the finished Energy Crystal it is built from carries no charge.
tools._comment_lapotronCrystalInputRate: Max EU/t a Lapotron Crystal accepts in a charge slot.
tools._comment_lvPouchCapacity: Battery Pouch item-storage capacity in weight units (one ordinary item = 1).
tools._comment_lvPouchDrainPerSecond: EU the pouch drains per second while carried and holding items (locks at 0 EU until recharged).
tools._comment_magnetAdvancedEuPerItem: EU the advanced electromagnet spends per item pulled each scan tick.
tools._comment_magnetAdvancedEuPerOrb: EU the advanced electromagnet spends per experience orb pulled.
tools._comment_magnetAdvancedInputRate: Max EU/t the advanced electromagnet accepts while charging in a slot.
tools._comment_magnetAdvancedRange: Advanced electromagnet pull radius in blocks around the carrier.
tools._comment_magnetEuPerItem: EU the electromagnet spends per item pulled each scan tick (an idle scan is free).
tools._comment_magnetInputRate: Max EU/t the electromagnet accepts while charging in a slot.
tools._comment_magnetRange: Electromagnet pull radius in blocks around the carrier.
tools._comment_magnetScanIntervalTicks: How often (ticks) the electromagnet scans for and pulls nearby drops.
tools._comment_magnetVanillaOrbReach: Distance under which the magnet leaves experience orbs to vanilla's own pull.
tools._comment_resonantCrystalBuffer: EU a blank Resonant Crystal must absorb. Sized against the 128 EU/t charge ceiling; raise it only together with an HV item charger.
tools._comment_resonantCrystalInputRate: Max EU/t a Resonant Crystal accepts in a charge slot.
tools._comment_scytheBonusSeedMultiplier: Global multiplier on the scythe's per-tier bonus-seed chance (1.0 = shipped ladder, 0.0 = mechanic off; a tier is clamped to 1.0).
tools._comment_shieldingPouchCapacity: Shielding Pouch item-storage capacity in weight units (one ordinary item = 1).

_comment_logistics: Moving things around: item and fluid pipes, the pump, portable tanks, the teleporter and the stock display frame.

logistics._comment_fluidPipeAdvancedSegmentBuffer: Per-segment buffer of the ADVANCED fluid pipe in mB — also its throughput. An ordinary pipe in the line slows it. Applies to newly placed pipes.
logistics._comment_fluidPipeSegmentBuffer: Per-segment fluid buffer in mB — also the segment's throughput, since fluid flows through the buffer one hop per tick (MOD-151). Applies to newly placed pipes.
logistics._comment_fluidTankAdvancedCapacity: Advanced fluid tank capacity in mB (1000 mB = 1 bucket). Applies to newly placed tanks.
logistics._comment_fluidTankCapacity: Portable fluid tank capacity in mB (1000 mB = 1 bucket). Applies to newly placed tanks.
logistics._comment_itemPipeAdvancedItemsPerTransfe: Items an ADVANCED item-pipe network moves per transfer. A network runs at its weakest pipe.
logistics._comment_itemPipeItemsPerTransfer: Items an item-pipe network moves per transfer. With the interval below this sets throughput.
logistics._comment_itemPipeTransferIntervalTicks: Server ticks between item-pipe transfers (20 = once per second).
logistics._comment_monitorCardTrackedTypes: How many distinct item types one Capacity Card lets a monitoring wall track.
logistics._comment_monitorCoreIdleEuPerTick: EU per tick a Monitor Core costs on its own, with no panel showing a number.
logistics._comment_monitorPanelEuPerTick: EU per tick added for each panel that is actually displaying a count.
logistics._comment_monitorScanIntervalTicks: How often (ticks) a Monitor Core re-reads the containers wired to it.
logistics._comment_pumpBuffer: Pump EU buffer. Applies to newly placed blocks.
logistics._comment_pumpEuPerBucket: EU the pump spends per bucket of fluid it moves (extract + push).
logistics._comment_pumpLitHoldTicks: How many ticks lit (and the working hum) stays on after the pump's last bucket transfer.
logistics._comment_pumpScanCooldownTicks: How many ticks the pump waits after a BFS scan before scanning again.
logistics._comment_pumpScanMaxDistance: Max Manhattan distance the pump BFS searches for a fluid source.
logistics._comment_pumpScanMaxVisited: Max blocks the pump BFS visits per scan, caps lag.
logistics._comment_stockFrameScanIntervalTicks: How often (ticks) a Stock Display Frame rescans the container behind it.
logistics._comment_teleporterBaseCost: Flat EU part of a jump's price (paid even for a short hop).
logistics._comment_teleporterBuffer: Teleporter station EU buffer. Applies to newly placed stations.
logistics._comment_teleporterCapsuleDoorOpenTicks: Ticks a teleporter capsule door stays open after a click before it closes itself.
logistics._comment_teleporterCapsuleDoorRecheckTic: Ticks a teleporter capsule door waits before re-testing a doorway that still has someone in it.
logistics._comment_teleporterCapsuleDoorSlideTicks: Ticks the capsule door takes to slide its full height; cosmetic only, the open state flips in one tick.
logistics._comment_teleporterCostPerBlock: Added EU per block of straight-line distance to the target station.
logistics._comment_teleporterMaxPoints: Max stations one teleport remote can hold.
logistics._comment_teleporterRtpCost: Flat EU a random jump costs, paid by the station the remote has selected.
logistics._comment_teleporterRtpMaxAttempts: How many candidate spots a random jump tries before giving up. Giving up costs nothing.
logistics._comment_teleporterRtpMinRadius: Inner edge of that ring: a random jump never leaves the player closer than this.
logistics._comment_teleporterRtpRadius: Outer edge of the ring a random jump throws the player into, in blocks.
logistics._comment_teleporterWarmupCancelRadius: Moving further than this many blocks from where warmup started cancels the jump.
logistics._comment_teleporterWarmupTicks: Warmup before a jump fires (20 ticks = 1 second). Cancelled by damage.

_comment_player: Mod XP, the player profile curve, and what each Workstation skill is worth.

player._comment_euPerXp: MOD-133 player profile: useful EU (from completed machine operations) per 1 point of mod XP. Higher = slower progression. Starting value, tune after playtest.
player._comment_euPerXpGenerated: MOD-133 player profile: produced EU (actually credited into a generator buffer, never idle overflow) per 1 point of mod XP. Much higher than euPerXp on purpose - a generator runs unattended, so it only trickles. Starting value, tune after playtest.
player._comment_levelXpMultiplier: MOD-133: per-level XP cost multiplier (exponential curve over 40 levels). Must be > 1.0.
player._comment_skillBackgroundShiftFactor: MOD-483 Background Shift: multiplier on the interval between radiation hits (2 = half as often). Not immunity - dose and symptoms are untouched.
player._comment_skillCarefulWearPercent: MOD-483 Careful Wear: percent more dose absorbed per point of hazmat durability (25 = the suit lasts a quarter longer).
player._comment_skillCrystalCarePercent: MOD-483 Crystal Care: percent faster greenhouse growth, read through the sprinkler's owner (the greenhouse controller has no owner of its own).
player._comment_skillDielectricPercent: MOD-483 Dielectric: percent by which a bare cable hits weaker.
player._comment_skillDosimetristRadius: MOD-483 Dosimetrist: Geiger counter reach in blocks with the skill (base geigerRadius applies without it).
player._comment_skillExtendedRoundRadius: MOD-483 Extended Round: garden-drone radius with the skill. 6 against a base of 4 is exactly double the area; doubling the radius would be four times.
player._comment_skillFieldCircuitDivisor: MOD-483 Field Circuit: divisor on the pack's output rate while it sits in a bag rather than worn (2 = half speed). Keeps wearing it worthwhile.
player._comment_skillFineTuningPercent: MOD-483 Fine Tuning: further percent off machine operation length, added to skillTunedDrivePercent.
player._comment_skillFrugalArmourEverySeconds: MOD-483 Frugal Armour: one second of powered-armour upkeep in this many is free (3 = a third off). Counted in seconds because upkeep is 1 EU and a percent of one rounds to nothing.
player._comment_skillFrugalFluidPercent: MOD-483 Frugal Sprayer / Frugal Vat: percent less solution or water one action takes.
player._comment_skillFrugalStrokePercent: MOD-483 Frugal Stroke: powered-tool action cost as a percent of the listed price (90 = 10% off). Rounded UP, so a 2 EU action is not halved.
player._comment_skillFullInsulationPercent: MOD-483 Full Insulation: percent by which a bare cable hits weaker. Together with a full insulating set it reaches the mod cap of 95%, never immunity.
player._comment_skillPreciseDrawEveryTicks: MOD-483 Precise Draw: one drain tick in this many is free (10 = 10% off the operation). Counted in ticks because a basic machine draws 2 EU/t.
player._comment_skillQuickDockFactor: MOD-483 Quick Docking: multiplier on how fast powered items accept charge (1.5 = half again). The voltage tier ceiling still applies above it.
player._comment_skillRecuperatorPercent: MOD-483 Recuperator: percent of a tool's spend returned to the worn energy pack. Never applies to a carrier's own payout - that would mint EU.
player._comment_skillResilientFromPercent: MOD-483 Resilient Cycle: percent of an operation that must be done before it may finish on the machine's own buffer. Below 50 a switch on a timer becomes free energy.
player._comment_skillRespiratorPercent: MOD-483 Respirator: percent by which radiation dose builds slower. Deliberately below one suit piece (25%) - a skill must not replace the gear.
player._comment_skillSelectionBonus: MOD-483 Selection: mutation chance added in the incubator (0.05 = five points). Applied to the base chance, so mutationChanceCap still has the last word.
player._comment_skillSteadyHandsPercent: MOD-483 Steady Hands: percent longer fuel burns in the owner's generators. Applied to burn LENGTH, not EU/t - a solar panel makes 1 EU/t and a percent of one is zero.
player._comment_skillSwiftDroneTicks: MOD-483 Swift Drone: ticks shaved off each block of garden-drone flight.
player._comment_skillTunedDrivePercent: MOD-483 Tuned Drive: percent off machine operation length. Small on purpose next to an overclocker chip, which buys 25% speed for 60% more energy.
player._comment_skillWideWateringCost: MOD-483 Wide Watering: multiplier on solution per pass that pays for the larger area (1.5 keeps the cost per tile roughly level; 1.0 hands out 49% free work).
player._comment_skillWideWateringRadius: MOD-483 Wide Watering: blocks added to sprinkler radius. Area grows with the SQUARE of it, which is why skillWideWateringCost exists.
player._comment_statsFlushTicks: MOD-133: how often (server ticks) in-memory player stats fold into the attachment and sync. 100 = every 5s.
player._comment_xpLevelOneCost: MOD-133: XP cost of the first level (1->2); each later level costs levelXpMultiplier x the previous. Starting value.

_comment_world: World behaviour: bonus chest injection, burning oil, crop growth.

world._comment_bonusChestEnabled: When true, mod starter items are injected into the vanilla bonus chest at world creation (vanilla loot kept). false = purely vanilla bonus chest.
world._comment_cottonFruitingChanceDivisor: Cotton trellis: 1-in-this chance of advancing one fruiting stage per random tick (the repeating harvest cycle).
world._comment_cottonRootingChanceDivisor: Cotton trellis: 1-in-this chance of advancing one rooting stage per random tick (higher = longer initial growth).
world._comment_kokSagyzRootTipDivisor: Kok sagyz: 1-in-this chance per random tick of growing the harvestable root tip, at any depth.
world._comment_kokSagyzRootUpperDivisor: Kok sagyz: 1-in-this chance per random tick of growing the intermediate root under the flower.
world._comment_kokSagyzSandGrowthPercent: Kok sagyz: a step in sand takes this percent of the time it takes in other ground. 100 removes the sand bonus; values above 100 are clamped.
world._comment_kokSagyzStage1Divisor: Kok sagyz: 1-in-this chance per random tick of going rosette -> bud, on tended ground.
world._comment_kokSagyzStage2Divisor: Kok sagyz: 1-in-this chance per random tick of going bud -> open flower, on tended ground.
world._comment_kokSagyzStage3Divisor: Kok sagyz: 1-in-this chance per random tick of going flower -> seed head, on tended ground.
world._comment_kokSagyzTrampling: Kok sagyz: landing on a flower from above knocks it back one growth stage. Walking through and sneaking never trample.
world._comment_oilBurns: When true, oil ignites from adjacent fire or flint-and-steel and the burn spreads across the pool; lava alone does not ignite it. false = oil is inert.
world._comment_oilSootChance: Chance (0..1) that a burnt-out oil fire leaves a soot layer on a solid floor under it (0 = never, 1 = always).
world._comment_welcomeMessageEnabled: When true, the mod writes a two-line welcome with its Discord link the first time anyone joins a world.

_comment_builtinDefaults: Written by the mod - do not edit. For each knob, the mod's own default at the moment this file was last saved. On load, a knob still holding exactly that number counts as untouched, so a mod update that changes the default applies it here too (the change is logged). A knob you edited to anything else is left alone forever. NOTE: a value you deliberately set to the same number as the default cannot be told apart from one you never touched, and will follow the default when it changes. NOTE: for files created before this block existed, the reference point is the moment it was added - defaults that drifted before that are not recoverable.
